title: First-class Tag Creation Delivery
summary: give New Tag its own validated mutation contract so ordinary creation no longer depends on bulk registry import
content_html:
First-class Tag Creation Delivery

Complete Result

New Tag creates exactly one canonical tag through a first-class server mutation and no longer calls the bulk tag-registry import route.

The user-visible creation workflow remains the same: choose a group, enter a slug and description, create, then reload the canonical registry and record activity evidence.

Why This Comes First

The current browser create path sends a one-row registry payload to the import endpoint in add mode. Bulk import cannot be removed safely until ordinary creation has its own contract.

In Scope

  • Add a focused create planner and server request/response contract through the Studio tag mutation boundary.
  • Enforce allowed group, <group>:<slug> identity, duplicate rejection, description normalization, and server-owned timestamps.
  • Add one row without rewriting unrelated registry rows.
  • Use the existing allowlisted atomic write and activity owners, with a distinct create action rather than import-shaped evidence.
  • Switch the New Tag browser workflow to the create operation.
  • Preserve the supported manual JSON patch fallback when the local write service is unavailable.
  • Cover service, route, browser payload, runtime configuration, and activity behavior with focused tests.

Not In Scope

  • Removing or changing bulk import UI and endpoints; that belongs to the final removal delivery.
  • Changing edit, delete, demotion, aliases, assignments, or tag groups.
  • Adding document associations or other registry fields.
  • Changing existing canonical tag records.

Likely Authority

  • studio/services/tags/tag_source_model.py
  • studio/services/tags/tag_registry_mutations.py
  • studio/services/tags/tag_write_transactions.py
  • studio/app/server/studio/studio_tag_api/registry.py
  • studio/app/server/studio/studio_tags_api.py
  • studio/app/frontend/js/tag-registry-service.js
  • studio/app/frontend/js/tag-registry.js
  • Studio runtime service and activity configuration
  • focused tag registry planner, route, workflow, and smoke tests

These are inspection starting points, not a requirement to change every file.

Completion And Evidence

  • A valid request adds exactly one normalized registry row and leaves all existing rows unchanged.
  • Invalid group, malformed slug, duplicate ID, and malformed payload requests fail before any write.
  • New Tag no longer requests the import endpoint in direct-write mode.
  • Successful creation reloads canonical data and records one create-tag activity action.
  • Manual patch mode still produces one valid row without implying that it was written.
  • Focused planner/API tests, route/module integration checks, and a manual New Tag interaction pass support only these claims.
  • studio/data/canonical/tags/tag-registry.json is unchanged by delivery implementation and verification.

Durable Destination

Transfer the shipped create workflow and extension boundary to Tag Registry.
